verses.jud-li-bikhayri-khalifatin-jud-li-bihi-c: jud lī bikhayri khalīfati jud lī bihi wabʿilmihi wabirushdihi ʾaw ṭībihi
la yaʿrifu th-thaqalani ʾawlā minhu bil- ʾikrāmi ʾaw bil-juhdi fī tarḥībihi
qiyamu taṣāʿadu minhu ḥattā ḥuwwilat maṭarā yaṣūbu l-khayru min shuʾubūbihi
ʿāshat khawāriquhu waʿāsha ṣalaḥuhu fatawāzana l-ʾashayāʾu min tarkībihi
ʾaddū shahādatahum ʾamāma surātihim fataʿʿajabū min ḥaẓẓihi wanaṣībihi
ḥattā wafī l-ʾaṭfāli minhu māʾāthiru ʿarafū binūri fīhi qabla ḥalībihi
fatafattaqat ʾazhāru rawḍaḍi ḥubbihi fī ʾaʿyuni ṭ-ṭulabi kay tazhū bihi
tatawāradu l-ʾafrādu fī ʾaknāfihi shaghafā bihi wabimā badā liraqībihi
takhtāru kullu jamāʿati mīqātahu liyarudda ʿanhā sh-sharra bīsmi ḥasībihi
ḥakamu yarā ʾanna l-ḥaḍārata lam takun ʾila liʾisʿādi mriʾi waqarībihi
ʾaw la, fakullu ḥaḍārati mashʾūmatu yashqā bihā l-ʾinsānu raghma mujībihi
lam yaltafit likawārithi waḥawādithi laqiyā z-zamāna walam yafuh biʿuyūbihi
qad ʾanqadha l-ʿulamāʾa min qalaqi bihim mā l-ghammu yarghabu fī liqāʾi ḥabībihi
wakadhā t-tafāʾulu bir-riḍā darsu lahu wamabādiʾu t-takwīni min tartībihi
ḥattā ghadā sh-shayṭānu yaṣrukhu kullamā ʿarafa l-khasārata muthqala bidhunūbihi
mā sabba ʾaʿdāʾa walakin ʿindahu ḥujaju taṣūnu l-ḥurra ʿan maḥjūbihi
shayʾu ʿajību fahmuhu wadhakāʾuhu ʾalikulli fahmi mithlu mā liʿajībihi?
la la wafī l-ʾādābi fardu zamānihi ʾinna z-zamāna muʾaddabu biʾadībihi
kānat tunāwiʾuhu l-ʾajillahu ghaflaha fatanāzalat min baʿdu ʿan ʿurqūbihi
wakadhā tuḥāwilu ʾan tasīra masīrahu ʾūlū l-ʿamāʾimi ʾaw tanī birukūbihi
famina l-jahālati ʾan tuqārana jannatu bijahhanami wal-farqu fī taṣwībihi
tilka l-ḥaqīqatu la tuqāsu biʿādati ʿamyāʾa mā nafakhūhu fī ʾunbūbihi
daʿnī ʾaqul laka mā jarā fī ʿaṣrihi lammā daʿā dāʿi ʾilā tajrībihi
wajadūhu ʾaqwā man yaḍinnu bimajdihi ʾasadā ʾidhā ftakhara llaʾīmu bidhībihi
ẓ-ẓulmu fī l-ʾislami jiddu safāhati falarubbamā naqalūhu ʿan tahdhībihi
ʾakhlaquhu tazkū bitaqdīrātihi lam yaqbali l-ʾisrāfa fī tadrībihi
nafsu binafsi ḥikmahu marḍiyyatu ʿaynu biʿayni jāʾa min maktūbihi
ʾinna l-ḥayāta baliyyatu warawiyyatu wahumā l-jihādu walaw ʿalā takhrībihi
fī l-ʿafwi ʾajru mā badā laka rādiʿā qad qādahu yawmā ʾilā maṣḥūbihi
fashajāʿatu bilaṭāfati wasiyādatu biwiqāyati yaqḍī bihā liwujūdihi
yā qāʾidī hal fī riḍāka ḥimāyatī ʾalikulli ʿaṣri raḥmahu bigharībihi
hadhī yadī khudhhā tafuz bimarāmihā yā wāhibā yansābu fī mawhūbihi
ʾinnī ʾukhāṭibu man yukhāṭabu dāʾimā ʾin sāra dahru lil-warā bikhuṭūbihi
bimuhimmahi ʾaw ḥājati maqḍiyyati fī nafsi khayri mubashshari yaʿqūbihi
kun lī maladhā mā jarā lī ḥādithu mimmā yashāʾu llāhu fī majlūbihi
wādʿu l-ʾilaha riʿāyata lijamāʿati tasʿā maʿī saʿyā bila tathrībihi
tallāhi lam yura mithluhu fī qawmihi fasali l-bisāṭa shabābahu fī shībihi
